meta.name: Wearable corroboration registry (question → wearable-metric → tolerance)
meta.flag: illustrative — tolerances are design defaults, calibrate per device/cohort before production
meta.idea: Types the 'wearable-match' stage: the question bank's free-text-ish wearable.<metric> corroborations are normalized to a canonical wearable metric (Appendix B), assigned a typed source channel, and given a per-metric TOLERANCE — the agreement band between the self-reported answer (perceived) and the wearable actual, beyond which a perceived↔actual gap is flagged. This makes stage-3 auditable: every wearable corroboration resolves to a metric + tolerance the gap engine can apply.
meta.tolerance_semantics: |perceived − actual| > tolerance ⇒ flag a perceived-vs-actual gap (Appendix F) and lower Confidence (Doc 12). Consumer/inferential metrics never drive a band on their own (D22).
meta.normalizes: Casing/alias variants collapse to one id (wearable.hrv = wearable.HRV; wearable.SpO2 = wearable.spo2; wearable.resting_hr = wearable.resting_HR; wearable.steps ≈ wearable.step_count).

metrics.name: Resting HR
metrics.perceived_actual: self-rated fitness / palpitations vs measured resting HR

metrics.name: Steps
metrics.perceived_actual: self-reported daily activity vs measured steps

metrics.name: MVPA
metrics.perceived_actual: self-reported exercise vs measured moderate-vigorous minutes

metrics.name: Sedentary time
metrics.perceived_actual: self-reported sitting vs measured sedentary minutes

metrics.name: Sleep duration
metrics.perceived_actual: self-reported sleep time vs measured total sleep

metrics.name: Sleep efficiency
metrics.perceived_actual: self-rated sleep quality vs measured efficiency

metrics.name: VO₂max (estimate)
metrics.perceived_actual: self-rated fitness vs estimated VO₂max (informational, D22)

metrics.name: HR recovery
metrics.perceived_actual: self-rated fitness vs measured HR recovery

metrics.name: Stress score
metrics.perceived_actual: perceived stress (PSS) vs device stress score (informational, D22)

metrics.name: Blood pressure (cuff)
metrics.perceived_actual: self-reported BP / symptoms vs validated home cuff (can drive a band, D22)

metrics.name: Single-lead ECG / rhythm
metrics.perceived_actual: palpitations PRO vs single-lead AFib detection (needs clinical confirm)

metrics.name: Fall detection
metrics.perceived_actual: falls-history PRO vs detected fall events
